jobs.description:
For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

For our client in the Veurne area, we are looking for a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-known garage in Veurne with a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. They are looking for a new colleague to join their team.

They are a well-established garage with a modern, clean and fully equipped workshop.

As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, your responsibilities will include:

  • Working independently on cars and vans;
  • Carrying out technical and electrical maintenance on passenger cars and vans;
  • Performing diagnostics on vehicles;
  • Dismantling and repairing engines;
  • Replacing timing belts.
As a DIAGNOSTIC TECHNICIAN in the Veurne area, you meet the following requirements:

  • You have experience as a vehicle mechanic, preferably with experience as a diagnostic technician;
  • You are in possession of a valid category B driving licence;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an independent electrician who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join a working environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialized in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a SHIP ELECTRICIAN.

As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN, your responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out electrical maintenance and repair work on ships;
  • Working on different ships, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on site and working independently on the planned tasks;
  • Performing electrical tests and inspections;
  • Disconnecting electrical components and wiring from engines;
  • Troubleshooting electrical faults and finding suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out electrical interventions and repairs;
  • Actively thinking along with technical challenges and independently looking for solutions.
As a SHIP ELECTRICIAN in OSTEND, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial electricity;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You preferably have experience in an industrial environment;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You are able to work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are a real problem-solver who takes initiative and looks for solutions yourself;
  • You are not afraid to take responsibility.

Are you an independent mechanic who enjoys working on technical projects and is not afraid of a new challenge?

Would you like to work on ships and join an environment where you are given a lot of responsibility and freedom?

For a growing company specialised in ship repair and technical maintenance, we are looking for a MARINE MECHANIC.

As a SHIP MECHANIC, your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing mechanical maintenance and repairs on ships;
  • Working on different vessels, both at the workshop in Ostend and on-site throughout West Flanders;
  • Starting on-site and working independently on the scheduled tasks;
  • Being responsible for the maintenance, dismantling and assembly of mechanical components;
  • Working on engines, drive systems, pumps and other mechanical installations;
  • Detecting mechanical faults and defects and providing suitable solutions;
  • Carrying out mechanical interventions and repairs;
  • Checking and testing installations after completing the work;
  • Actively thinking along with technical issues and independently looking for solutions.
As a MARINE MECHANIC in OSTEND, you recognise yourself in the following:

  • You have a technical education or background, preferably in industrial mechanics;
  • You speak Dutch OR English;
  • You have a valid driving licence B;
  • Previous experience in an industrial environment is preferred;
  • Experience in the maritime sector is a plus, but not an absolute requirement;
  • You can work independently and do not need constant supervision;
  • You are proactive and resourceful and know how to find solutions yourself;
  • You are willing to take responsibility.

For our client, we are looking for a PLASTERER.

As an all-round plasterer, you will be responsible for various plastering and finishing works. You will work on both interior and exterior projects and ensure a neat and high-quality finish every time.

Your responsibilities as a PLASTERER:

  • Carrying out plastering works;
  • Preparing surfaces;
  • Applying and finishing interior and exterior plaster;
  • Repairing and touching up existing plasterwork;
  • Finishing corners, edges and connections;
  • Working with spray cork;
  • Working with different materials and techniques;
  • Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish;
  • Working on different construction sites and projects.
This is you as a PLASTERER:

  • You have experience as a plasterer or renovation worker;
  • You can work independently, but also work well as part of a team;
  • You have an eye for detail and deliver a neat finish;
  • You are physically fit;
  • You speak Dutch or fluent Englisch;
  • You have a valid category B driving licence.

For our client located in BRUGES, we are looking for a ROOFER.

Do you enjoy working at heights and do you have experience as a roofer, mainly working on pitched roofs? Then we are looking for you!

As a ROOFER in the Bruges region, your day will look like this:

  • Mainly covering pitched roofs, but occasionally also flat roofs;
  • Renovating existing roofs (no new-build projects);
  • Installing roofing materials;
  • Assessing the structural characteristics of existing roofs;
  • Installing and sealing carpentry elements in the roof;
  • Bonding and installing EPDM.
As a ROOFER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a roofer, with experience working on pitched roofs;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges, Blauwe-Toren area;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the BRUGES region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the BRUGES region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in BRUGES, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and do you like renovation work? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a RENOVATION WORKER in the VEURNE region, your day will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you will carry out demolition and repair work as part of renovation projects;
  • Carrying out general renovation works on houses and buildings;
  • Demolition works and preparing the construction site;
  • Bricklaying, plastering and small concrete works;
  • Installing and repairing floors and walls;
  • Installing insulation and drywall/plasterboard;
  • Ensuring that the entire renovation project is completed to a high standard;
  • Ensuring that structural works and stability requirements are properly taken into account.
As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you have the following qualities:

  • You have solid work experience as a renovation worker and are fully familiar with flooring, carpentry, bricklaying, etc.;
  • You have a category B driving licence;
  • The starting location is Bruges (Blauwe-Toren), at the company’s warehouse;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You are not afraid of heights.

For our client located in Bredene, we are looking for a CNC TURNER.

As a CNC TURNER in the Bredene region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • You will sometimes produce small series of parts, while other times you will make unique, customer-specific pieces;
  • You will work on a wide range of components, from large rollers and large-diameter parts to wear sleeves for pumps and parts for combine harvesters;
  • You will start with smaller pieces and gradually grow into working on larger components;
  • To work efficiently, you can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You manufacture unique parts based on technical drawings, with little repetitive series work;
  • You accurately measure and check finished products.
As a CNC TURNER in the BREDENE region, you can identify with the following:

  • You have experience as a conventional turner, milling machine operator or CNC turner? Great, we are looking for you!
  • We have approximately 25 machines. You will not have a fixed workstation but will learn to operate almost all of them. You will start on a standard lathe and gradually develop your skills;
  • You can read and understand technical drawings;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

As an ELECTROMECHANIC – DAY SHIFT in WEST FLANDERS, you will work closely with our clients to ensure the optimal performance and efficiency of their machinery and contribute to their operational success.

Your responsibilities as an ELECTROMECHANIC in WEST FLANDERS:

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical and electrical faults, including under time pressure;
  • Carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule;
  • Actively contribute ideas for improvements related to machinery, safety, quality and efficiency;
  • Participate in optimization and continuous improvement projects;
  • Contribute to a smooth and efficient production environment;
  • Work in a refrigerated production environment (4–6°C) that is cleaned industrially on a daily basis. Safety, cleanliness and quality are key priorities.
AS AN ELECTROMECHANIC IN WEST FLANDERS, YOU RECOGNIZE YOURSELF IN THE FOLLOWING:
  • You have a degree in electromechanics or relevant experience as a maintenance or breakdown technician, with a strong focus on electrical systems;
  • You have an analytical mindset and can quickly identify and resolve technical faults efficiently;
  • You can work independently and take responsibility in a mature and professional manner;
  • You have a good command of Dutch or English;
  • You are motivated to grow and develop within a company that is continuously expanding.

Apply now for this vacancy or send your CV to westkust@absolutejobs.be.

For our client in the DIKSMUIDE area, we are looking for a SHEET METAL WORKER.

Our client is a company where employees are at the heart of the business and where everyone is given the opportunity to develop their skills and receive further training.

Since 1957, the company has been a leading metalworking company serving Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg and Northern France.

As a PLATE WORKER in the DIKSMUIDE area, your responsibilities will include:

  • You will be flexibly deployed within the sheet metal department according to the needs of the planning;
  • You operate and set up machines for laser cutting, bending and rolling sheet metal;
  • You prepare the necessary programs and machine settings and check that the machines are functioning correctly;
  • You perform some basic administrative tasks, such as receiving incoming sheets, checking stock and entering the information into the system;
  • You ensure the proper finishing of the parts, including deburring and quality control;
  • You independently move sheets and finished parts using a forklift.
What does our client in the DIKSMUIDE area expect from a new SHEET METAL WORKER colleague?

  • You have experience in sheet metal processing and preferably have experience with several of the following techniques: laser cutting, bending, nesting and rolling;
  • You have a valid forklift certificate;
  • You can read technical drawings and work accurately;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have completed a technical education (A2 level), for example in mechanics or metalworking, or have equivalent experience.

For our client in MIDDELKERKE, we are looking for a CHEF – THAI CUISINE.

This is a family-run business where, in time, you will have the opportunity to run the entire kitchen independently and take on responsibility within the business.

Do you have extensive knowledge of Asian cuisine, or do you have solid experience as a chef and are you eager to learn Thai cuisine? Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Your responsibilities as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You are responsible for preparing dishes from the Thai cuisine;
  • You take care of the mise-en-place;
  • You cut vegetables and prepare meat and vegetable ingredients;
  • You ensure a professional presentation and finishing of the dishes;
  • You check deliveries and ensure that products are stored correctly;
  • You correctly store all products in the cold room; this is physically demanding work;
  • In time, you will take full responsibility for the kitchen and the entire menu independently;
  • You actively contribute to the daily operation and take responsibility within the kitchen.
This is you as CHEF – THAI CUISINE in MIDDELKERKE:

  • You have experience as a chef, preferably within Thai or Asian cuisine;
  • You can work independently and are comfortable taking responsibility;
  • A good command of English is important to learn and follow the recipes correctly;
  • You are reliable and take ownership of your kitchen;
  • You work accurately and maintain high standards of hygiene;
  • You are flexible and stress-resistant during busy services;
  • You are motivated to take on full responsibility for the kitchen in the long term.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 
 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
 
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
 
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
 
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
 
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
 
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
 
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
 
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs. 

Your Profile
 

 
• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
 
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
 
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
 
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
 
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
 
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
 
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
 
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
 
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

Support the CEO and executive leadership team by ensuring the smooth coordination of administrative, organizational, marketing, and operational activities.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established organization operating in a dynamic and professional environment, offering a central role with direct exposure to senior management and strategic decision-making.

Description

• Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, and appointments.
• Coordinate recurring management, board, and shareholder meetings.
• Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including urgent matters.
• Maintain and update key contacts and administrative records.
• Prepare meeting materials and coordinate attendees.
• Support telephone reception and general administrative tasks.
• Assist with marketing activities, including client events, website management, and LinkedIn communications.
• Coordinate facility-related projects and external service providers across offices.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, or Office Manager.
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good level of English.
• Proactive, autonomous, and highly organized.
• Professional, discreet, and trustworthy.
• Strong communication skills and comfortable working with senior stakeholders.

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2
• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion
• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)
• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making
• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization
• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning
• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation
• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C  , and Python
• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization
• Control systems for robotics
• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)
• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics
• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment
• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work
• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)
• You can communicate fluently in English

jobs.occupation: AML & Financial Crime - International Bank - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international corporate and investment bank with a strong presence across EMEA. The organisation supports multinational clients through a broad range of banking, capital markets, and advisory services while maintaining a strong commitment to compliance, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

As an AML & Compliance professional your responsibilities are:

• Provide AML, sanctions, and financial crime guidance to business and support teams.
• Act as a key point of contact for financial crime compliance matters.
• Assess the impact of new regulations and support implementation projects.
• Investigate potential regulatory breaches and support remediation actions.
• Manage financial crime-related projects and report progress to senior management.
• Perform AML/KYC reviews during onboarding and periodic client reviews.
• Support regulatory, audit, and compliance recommendations implementation.
• Deliver AML/CTF training and awareness initiatives.
• Assist in drafting and updating compliance policies and procedures.
• Participate in Financial Crime Risk Assessments and mitigation initiatives.
• Contribute to compliance action plans and governance reporting.
• Prepare management information and committee reports.

A successful AML & Compliance professional should have:

• Degree in Law, Finance, Economics, Business or related field.
• Between 2 to 4 years of experience within AML, Compliance, Financial Crime or KYC.
• Good understanding of AML, sanctions and financial crime regulations.
• Knowledge of banking activities and financial markets.
• Experience with Customer Due Diligence (CDD) is an asset.
• Strong analytical and risk assessment skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong attention to detail and proactive mindset.
• Fluent English required.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + Polish + Lithuanian + English | Volvo Group | Gent
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English, Czech, Polish and Lithuanian (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.
